newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 20.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Friday:

WASHINGTON - The Justice Department task force investigating Democratic campaign contributions has issued wide-ranging subpoenas to the White House and Democratic National Committee for all records relating to a host of party fundraisers and donors.

WASHINGTON - A Democratic fundraiser with business dealings in China used his influence with party officials last February to bring the head of a weapons trading company owned by the Chinese military to a White House event hosted by President Bill Clinton.
WASHINGTON - President Clinton plans to essentially complete the reshuffle of his administration with the appointment of four more Cabinet secretaries and several other senior officials.
LIMA - The Peruvian government began the delicate task of negotiating the release of hundreds of hostages held by terrorists at the residence of the Japanese ambassador.

WASHINGTON - An ally of House Speaker Newt Gingrich acknowledged the speaker gave false information to the House ethics committee in its investigation of a college course he taught, but put the blame on Gingrich's former ethics lawyer.

WASHINGTON - The D.C. school chief has shut down a dilapidated, mostly empty middle school in Northeast Washington and said he is strongly considering the permanent closure of up to two dozen city schools over the next two years.
WASHINGTON - Tobacco and illegal drug use increased again last year among U.S. schoolchildren, an annual survey showed.

WASHINGTON - A D.C. grand jury indicted Mary Anigbo, the principal of Marcus Garvey Public Charter School and three staff members, on charges of misdemeanor assault in confrontation with a Washington Times reporter on December 3.
